notes: The supplied catalog text (pages 212-215) contains the end of a Liberal Arts emphasis list (social/behavioral sciences), the Liberal Arts & Sciences: Emphasis in Mathematics, Physical and Natural Sciences AA, and the Mathematics AS-T. None of these is the IGETC Certificate of Achievement, so no blocks, totals, outcomes or careers were recorded.

IGETC is mentioned only as a GE pattern option for continuing students in the degree sections; the IGETC certificate's own requirements page was not in the text. A reviewer should locate the correct page for this award.
Many closed-list courses appear in other programs' lists on these pages; they were not placed because those sections belong to other awards.
